items.summary: Từ ngày 1-1-2027, tổng diện tích 40,06km² thuộc các xã Thịnh Minh, Lương Sơn và phường Kỳ Sơn của tỉnh Phú Thọ được điều chỉnh về thành phố Hà Nội, với quy mô dân số 1.057 người.

items.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
items.summary: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.

items.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?
items.summary: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.

items.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years
items.summary: Elon Musk's social network X has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see on the platform.

items.title: A month with the iPhone Duo has changed how I use my phone
items.summary: From reading more books to breaking mindless scrolling habits, Apple's foldable has changed my daily routines in ways I didn't anticipate.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn’t a virtue
items.summary: On the same day that Anthropic entered the public market, a painstakingly human video game became one of most successful entertainment launches of all time.
